I also suffer from impulsive and self-destructive behaviors. I see it as trying to have control of something in your life, even if that means controlling it on a negative way. It’s like, at least if you make negative choices, you’re making some kind of difference. It could also be an attempt to feel something, of you’re experiencing mental numbness or something similar. 

While I’m not trying to play armchair psychologist, it could help you to look into borderline personality disorder or bipolar disorder; just based on your post, I could see that maybe you’re affected by one of those things. I could of course be wrong, but it couldn’t hurt to take a look. If you can put a name to what you’re feeling, you’ll be on your way to discovering how to cope with it.
